entries.speaker: Making Plans for Tomorrow
entries.en: If you respond right away to a Confidant's[n]invitation without putting it on Hold, your[n]relationship will deepen.

entries.speaker: Making Plans for Tomorrow
entries.en: If you immediately respond to a message, your[n]schedule for that day will be filled and you will[n]be unable to do anything else that day. Be sure[n]to consider an invitation before you commit to it.
